nom: Paula's Choice Resist Triple Active Total Repair Serum

avis.texte: I am happy with Paula’s Choice had been using more expensive product and these work just as well!

This is a holy grail serum for acne prone skin! I am 47 and have hormonal acne. I take an oral prescription and the use this serum nightly for clear skin and anti aging benefits. I layer it after peach and Lily Rescue Party Barrier Restore Serum dries. It’s a perfect duo! I’ve used it for several years.

So I have been using this line for a couple of months now and I really like the texture, the product is not cheap but affordable 😁I love the smell, and you can tell the product is of very good quality.

This cream has a nice consistency and no smell which I like. However I haven’t seen any improvement in fine lines, sagging or pore size. It is quite expensive so I had high expectations. I won’t buy this brand again

avis.titre: Good! People asking what I did with my face!!
avis.texte: Does a nice job, actually one of my lasts best sellers. Sadly couldnt see any difference in my dark spots and fine lines, but texture is a bit better and leave the skin very glow

First time i tried this product, i felt my skin so smooth. After afew days i apply this on my face and neck ,the texture of my skin looks younger rather than before. Definately, ill buy again and higher recommend to my friend.

avis.titre: Fantastic ingredients with no “nasties” in an unscented, gentle serum. No tackiness.
avis.texte: Paula's Choice RESIST Triple Active Total Repair This serum arrived wrapped in plastic and there was a clear “Paula’s Choice Skincare” label connecting the bottle to the cap as an additional seal. The 1 fl oz /30 ml blue and white bottle is protective (opaque) and has a good pump with a clear cap that snaps into place. I knew I was going to like this gentle serum after the first application as there was no scent, it was a pleasure to apply, there was no tackiness, and my skin immediately felt good. Sometimes you just know. The white serum is lightweight and absorbed quickly. Two full pumps easily covered my face (including the undereye area) and neck. I’ve been using this on a clean face, twice a day, for over two weeks. I have acne-prone, combination skin and my skin really liked this serum. That first gut reaction turned out to be true. I didn’t experience any irritation, redness, or spots while using it. The “triple-action” ingredients are well described in the listing: .4% hexylresorcinol (for skin brightening), 5% niacinamide/vitamin B3 (4 to 5% is the right concentration for anti-aging benefits and is “anti-acne”), and .3% retinyl propionate (a retinol ester which is a gentler alternative to retinol). All great ingredients and no “nasties”. The three key ingredients work well together while still being a gentler serum. SPF 30 (or more) should be used after this during the day. Cruelty-Free and Leaping Bunny Certified. An icon tells me the serum will be good for 12 month
Can't help but notice that in the two other pics from customers that the product appears much thicker and a much lighter color than the orange-tinged watery serum I received. Is this okay to use?

avis.titre: Love this! Great for maturing skin
avis.texte: I’m really loving this gentle treatment! It says you can use it twice a day, but let’s face it…. Im a busy toddler mom and rarely do my morning skincare routine. It seems to be gentle enough to use twice a day, every day. No irritation. We’ll see how it does over the next couple weeks and if it helps any of my dullness, texture issues, or fine lines. So far I love the way my skin feels! UPDATE: one week in & my skin texture is more glowy & radiant! Not sure, but I think the retinol is helping existing breakouts heal faster and I’m not getting anything new popping up…. Even on my period. 🙌🏼 I’m wearing sunscreen daily. 2nd UPDATE: ok…. It’s been 3 months since I started using this nightly. I’m not perfect and probably forget to apply it a couple times a week, but I’m still noticing DRASTIC improvements with my skin texture. No noticeable changes with dark spots unfortunately, but I’m less bumpy and my pores are smaller. Out of all the retinol brands I’ve tried, this one works the best!

This serum is absolutely amazing, and this serum replaces so many individual serums I was using to try to get the same effect. I have had texture on my cheeks that I have been trying to get rid of for months, and after one night of wearing this serum, the texture was gone. My face feels so incredibly smooth and has a beautiful glow to it. This serum is moisturizing and does not pill with other serums I apply first or moisturizer I use last. This serum sinks into my skin beautifully and quickly, and does not leave me feeling sticky or looking greasy. This serum looks beautiful under makeup and does not cause it to break down throughout the day. This serum is such a powerhouse, and so surprisingly lightweight for how moisturizing it is. With continued use, I can not wait to see how much my skin continues to improve. This serum is supposed to lighten my dark spots and help with my aging/ fine lines which are my two biggest concerns now that the texture is gone. Thus far, my skin has become silky smooth, moisturized, radiant, and just looks so much healthier, and this is with only a few days and nights of use. This Paula's Choice Serum is definitely a must-have in my skincare routine from now on.

I’ve been using this for about a week now. So far I’ve been noticing any flaws…like acne, pimples etc. have just dried up and fallen off. Some with my help…I’m a picker lol My skin itself hasn’t been irritated or peeling like other retinols have done in the past. I’m excited to see if it helps with my age spots over time. Easy to use and no weird smell. Very happy so far!

I’m on day 4 from using this 2 times a day and so far I have no complaints. After applying my skin do feel well moisturized with no irritation It has no smell which I love and bottle is easy to store and prevents spill Feels nice and smooth when applying. I can’t say I see results yet but I’m not dissatisfied either . I’m Very happy with the ingredients hexylresorcinol, niacinamide & retinoid which is why I am rating so high because they are proven to give good results

I am 42 and a loss of firmness is definitely something that is starting to describe my face and neck. When I saw this I thought it was worth giving a try. What I know at this point, after a week of use, is that my skin feels amazing. So moisturized and healthy and soft. I'm loving it! Is it helping with the loss of firmness? I'm not sure yet but I know that I feel so good in my skin right now and that means a lot. I have sensitive skin and this hasn't irritated it at all, which is great! Definitely going to keep it up!
